subject: Oceanography
title: Ocean Observing Systems
description: A quick win: understand Ocean Observing Systems.

hook.text: Over 4,000 robotic floats drift through the ocean right now, reporting temperature and salinity every 10 days.

buildup.text: The Argo program deployed these floats globally to monitor the ocean's interior in real time.

discovery.text: Each float sinks to 2,000 meters, drifts for days, then surfaces to transmit data via satellite.

twist.text: Before Argo, deep-ocean temperature data was so sparse that climate models had huge blind spots.

climax.text: Argo data proved the deep ocean is absorbing most of the extra heat from global warming.

punchline.text: Thousands of silent robots keep watch on the hidden ocean.

quiz.question: What does the Argo float program monitor?
